final: WITH j AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS id, p.fundflux AS ff FROM projects p WHERE p.arcregistry IN (SELECT arcref FROM scanqc)), g AS (SELECT ff, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM j GROUP BY ff) SELECT ff AS fundflux, n AS project_count, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM g) AS fraction_of_total, n * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) FROM g) AS ratio_to_average FROM g ORDER BY n DESC
